sql: SELECT TOP 10 ol.OrderProductId AS lineItemId, ol.SKU AS sku, ol.Quantity AS quantity, os.OrderStateName AS orderLineItemStatus FROM dbo.ZnodeOrder o INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeOrderProduct ol ON ol.OrderId = o.OrderId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodeOmsOrderState os ON os.OmsOrderStateId = ol.OmsOrderStateId WHERE (@order IS NULL OR o.ClassNumber = @order) AND ol.IsAddOn = @notAddOn AND (@sku IS NULL OR ol.SKU = @sku) AND (@preferred IS NULL OR ol.OrderProductId = @preferred) ORDER BY ol.ProductSequence, ol.SKU
